feature: CN receiving Excel upload, decoded locally — the upload page takes 收货确认 Excel files alongside PDFs: the browser decodes each sheet (reusing the retained cnReceivingExcel parser) into a verify/edit section (header fields + brand + inline item table), and one submit creates one PENDING CN receiving order per file directly in the DB (invoice + items, line qty = sheet qty), no DocPal workflow.
